config.vignetteplus.title: Vignette + Settings
config.vignetteplus.option.mod_enabled.t: Turns every vignette on or off.
config.vignetteplus.option.all_transpare: Makes every vignette more transparent by this amount. 0% leaves them unchanged, 100% hides them.
config.vignetteplus.option.health_enable: If off, the Low Health Vignette settings and its color option are disabled.
config.vignetteplus.option.drowning_enab: If off, the Drowning Vignette settings and its color option are disabled.
config.vignetteplus.option.hunger_enable: If off, the Hunger Vignette settings and its color option are disabled.
config.vignetteplus.option.min_health_th: Health where the vignette starts to show, at its most transparent. In health points (2 = 1 heart).
config.vignetteplus.option.max_health_th: Health where the vignette is fully visible (0 transparency). In health points (2 = 1 heart).
config.vignetteplus.option.hunger_displa: Whether the vignette reacts to low saturation or low hunger.
config.vignetteplus.option.hunger_appear: Fade In: fades in smoothly. Appear: shows instantly. Transparency Matches: gets more visible the lower your saturation or hunger gets.
config.vignetteplus.option.hunger_min_tr: Transparency when you have just reached the threshold. Only used when Appear Type is Transparency Matches.
config.vignetteplus.option.hunger_max_tr: Transparency when saturation or hunger is completely empty. Only used when Appear Type is Transparency Matches.
config.vignetteplus.option.saturation_th: The vignette shows when saturation is at or below this. Only used when Display Type is Low Saturation.
config.vignetteplus.option.hunger_thresh: The vignette shows when the hunger bar is at or below this (20 = full). Only used when Display Type is Low Hunger.
config.vignetteplus.option.drowning_only: Show Only Below a Certain Health
If on, the drowning vignette only shows once your health is at or below the threshold.
config.vignetteplus.option.drowning_heal: Health at or below which the drowning vignette is allowed to show. In health points (2 = 1 heart).
config.vignetteplus.option.drowning_appe: Fade In: fades in smoothly. Appear: shows instantly. Adjust to Health Left: gets more visible the lower your health is.
config.vignetteplus.option.drowning_min_: Transparency when your health is at its lowest. Only used when Appear Type is Adjust to Health Left.
config.vignetteplus.option.drowning_max_: Transparency at the top of the health range (the threshold, or full health if the threshold option is off). Only used when Appear Type is Adjust to Health Left.
Color of the low health vignette.
